heritage.card4Desc: Batak Toba cultural heritage preserved and passed to future generations.
heritage.card5Desc: Natural beauty and coffee-farming traditions that remain vibrant to this day.

coffeeFarming.label: Agronomy & Production
coffeeFarming.subtitle: Every bean we produce starts from the volcanic highlands of Humbang Hasundutan — hand-harvested, traditionally processed, and meticulously tended.
coffeeFarming.processSubtitle: Six critical stages that transform cherry fruit into specialty-grade beans — all handled with precision and respect for tradition.
coffeeFarming.regionsSubtitle: Three key areas in North Sumatra, each lending a unique character to our coffee.
coffeeFarming.farmersSubtitle: 200+ partner farming families in Humbang Hasundutan — they are the real foundation of every Kopi Siholta product.
coffeeFarming.ctaSubtitle: PT Siholta Toba Indonesia is open to partnerships with coffee farmers and international buyers. Contact us to discuss further.
coffeeFarming.stepCherryDesc: Coffee cherries are hand-picked only when perfectly red. Each tree is visited multiple times to ensure perfection.
coffeeFarming.stepFermentDesc: Coffee beans ferment for 24–36 hours in traditional wooden barrels. This process develops complex flavor profiles.
coffeeFarming.stepWetHullDesc: The traditional Lintong method — fruit skin is removed, mucilage is fermented, producing the distinctive body of Tanah Batak coffee.
coffeeFarming.stepDryingDesc: Beans are spread on bamboo mats for 7–14 days, turned regularly under the tropical sun.
coffeeFarming.stepSortingDesc: Beans are hand- and machine-sorted. Only Grade 1 beans pass our international specialty coffee standards.
coffeeFarming.stepRoastingDesc: Light-medium roasted to highlight the signature Lintong spice and chocolate character.
coffeeFarming.regionLintongDesc: Main Arabica production area. Volcanic soil and cool climate create the spice profile recognized worldwide.
coffeeFarming.regionDolokDesc: Robusta region with bold body and strong chocolate aftertaste. Ideal for espresso blend.
coffeeFarming.regionHumbangDesc: PT Siholta operational heart. 200+ partner farming families across 7 villages in this area.
coffeeFarming.farmerMargondangQuote: Coffee has been in our blood for three generations.
coffeeFarming.farmerRohaniQuote: Since partnering with Siholta, our income increased 40% and we learned international standards.

tourism.label: Coffee Tourism Experience
tourism.subtitle: From the North Sumatra highlands, we invite you to experience the journey of coffee from tree to cup — an experience that transforms how you appreciate every sip.
tourism.expTitle: Three Ways to Enjoy Kopi Siholta
tourism.expSubtitle: Each experience is designed to bring you closer to the story behind every cup.
tourism.ctaTitle: Ready to Enjoy the Coffee Journey?
tourism.ctaSubtitle: Contact our team to schedule a farm tour, factory tour, or cupping session at our location.
tourism.exp1Desc: Explore our coffee plantations stretching across the North Sumatra highlands. Walk the fields with our farmers, hand-pick perfectly ripe cherries, and witness how nature and tradition work together to produce specialty coffee.
tourism.exp2Desc: Observe how our coffee is processed using the traditional Wet Hulling method — a technique preserved for decades and the defining character of authentic Lintong coffee.
tourism.exp3Desc: Our tasting room is designed to guide you through the complexity of specialty coffee — from spice to fruity, floral, to chocolate in a single sip.

company.heroSub: From the Humbang Hasundutan highlands to the world — a journey that begins with a single cup and the belief that Indonesian coffee deserves a global stage.
company.storyBody1: In 2019, PT Siholta Toba Indonesia was founded with one mission: to bring Humbang Hasundutan specialty coffee — known since the Dutch colonial era — to the global stage. "Siholta" means "ancient tree" in Batak language, symbolizing deep roots and cherished heritage.
company.storyBody2: From dozens of partner farmers on the Sumatera slopes, we have grown into an integrated specialty coffee company operating three business sectors — from agronomy to your cup.
company.timelineSubtitle: Six years building Indonesia's specialty coffee ecosystem — from farmer foundations to world standards.
company.sectorsSubtitle: PT Siholta Toba Indonesia runs its coffee business across three complementary sectors — from upstream to downstream.
company.locationSub: PT Siholta Toba Indonesia is headquartered in the Humbang Hasundutan highlands, North Sumatra — close to Indonesia's finest coffee-growing traditions.
company.ctaSubtitle: Interested in Humbang Hasundutan specialty coffee? Contact our team for partnerships, farm visits, or business inquiries.
company.milestone2019Desc: PT Siholta Toba Indonesia officially established. The journey begins from the Humbang Hasundutan highlands, working directly with traditional coffee-farming families.
company.milestone2020Desc: Collaboration with over 200 farming families in Lintong and Dolok. Traditional Wet Hulling is preserved as the authentic specialty marker.
company.milestone2021Desc: Kopi Siholta products launch on Tokopedia and Shopee. Indonesian specialty coffee brand starts reaching across the archipelago.
company.milestone2022Desc: Kopi Siholta meets global specialty coffee standards and begins exporting to America, Europe, and East Asia.
company.milestone2023Desc: Expansion into F&B and coffee tourism. Guests can now experience coffee from tree to cup at our location.
company.milestone2024Desc: PT Siholta Toba Indonesia sets a roadmap to become a leading Indonesian specialty coffee exporter, bringing Sumatra's name to the global stage.
company.sector1Desc: 200+ partner farming families across Lintong & Dolok highlands. Traditional Wet Hulling produces the unique specialty character Humbang Hasundutan coffee is known for worldwide.
company.sector2Desc: From beverages to food centered on Indonesian specialty coffee. Every F&B item is made with premium specialty-grade beans processed to specialty standards.
company.sector3Desc: Coffee tourism experiences from farm to production. Farm and factory tours available for guests who want to discover the full story behind every cup.
